bio: Lounge music in the background, trendy urban wall graffiti and the warm hospitality of Limburg: a meal at Magnific is always a treat. All the more so, as the chef cleverly juggles with French and Italian recipes, throwing in the odd Asian theme. Whether you start with cannelloni or continue with a venison steak and a cranberry sauce, you can rely on the stellar craftsmanship and full-bodied flavours to come up trumps every time! The set menu with choices is highly recommended....
